title: 2.39:1 letterbox on the motion promo
caption: The motion-graphics promo with a 2.39:1 cinema matte: black bars top and bottom turn the 16:9 frame into a widescreen look without re-rendering or cropping the picture underneath.
prompt: Give the Magnifito motion promo (../videos/06-motion-graphics.mp4) a cinematic widescreen feel: add black 2.39:1 letterbox bars over the full 12 seconds, keep the 1920x1080 frame, and save it as work/letterbox.mp4.
